commentkeyword/agent-toolkit.name: agent-toolkit
commentkeyword/agent-toolkit.note: Dependency-free Node stdio MCP server for CommentKeyword: create and manage Instagram comment-to-DM keyword automations (create_keyword, update_keyword, list_keywords, get_keyword, delete_keyword, list_agents). Install pinned: npx -y github:commentkeyword/agent-toolkit#v0.2.0; MCPB bundle in release v0.2.0, in the official MCP Registry. Needs a CommentKeyword API token. MIT.

NicksAdvisory/lintelly-hr-deutschland.note: TypeScript MCP server for German employment law (38 read-only tools, calculation and official source in every answer). Remote https://hr.lintelly.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth), npm @lintelly/hr-deutschland, in the official MCP Registry. MIT.

DarkWorldCoder/market-mirror.name: market-mirror
DarkWorldCoder/market-mirror.note: Local stdio MCP server (Python) that tests ads, prices, emails and sales pitches on simulated buyers and returns a go / iterate / no-go report. Not in the official MCP registry yet. AGPL-3.0.

stonianua/neither-mcp.name: neither-mcp
stonianua/neither-mcp.note: MCP access to selected notes and documents with retrieval evidence. Submitted stdio installation: npx -y @neitherai/mcp-server; requires NEITHER_API_KEY. Consult the repository for current setup and deployment requirements.

usenetstate/statsnet-mcp.name: statsnet-mcp
usenetstate/statsnet-mcp.note: Hosted company background checks covering registration, executives, courts and finances worldwide. Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://statsnet.co/mcp. Repository contains integration metadata and documentation; canonical metadata is in server.json.

screenpipe/screenpipe.name: screenpipe
screenpipe/screenpipe.note: Search captured screen text and audio transcripts. Requires a running Screenpipe recorder and SCREENPIPE_LOCAL_API_KEY; desktop Settings > Connections is the recommended setup. Package: screenpipe-mcp. Source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License, not OSI open source. Configured cloud AI, transcription, sync and integrations can transmit context off-device.

Noveum/api-market-agent-integrations.name: api-market-agent-integrations
Noveum/api-market-agent-integrations.note: Client configuration and documentation for the proprietary API.market hosted MCP gateway, not its server implementation. Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://api.market/api/mcp/gateway. Requires an account and OAuth (recommended) or an API key. API calls and subscription changes may incur charges; pricing and limits vary by API. Setup: https://api.market/mcp.

tonydzi/sqlite-graph-memory.name: sqlite-graph-memory
tonydzi/sqlite-graph-memory.note: Local stdio memory over your own markdown notes: vector retrieval, the notes' [[wikilinks]] as the graph, cross-encoder rerank, one SQLite file. No API key, nothing leaves the machine. PyPI sqlite-graph-memory; canonical metadata is in server.json.

louis030195/hyperconsciousness.name: hyperconsciousness
louis030195/hyperconsciousness.note: Developer-alpha Rust knowledge store with encrypted append-only records, sync and grant-scoped MCP retrieval. MIT. The submitted stdio setup requires building hc, initializing a store and creating a grant, then running hc mcp --as <grant-id> --dir /absolute/path/to/store. Grants constrain server responses, not owner-level OS processes; hosted models can see returned plaintext. No independent security audit is claimed.

cohesivity-org/cohesivity-plugin.name: cohesivity-plugin
cohesivity-org/cohesivity-plugin.note: cohesivity.ai offers free agent native backend services. Anonymous account (no-signup) to get started through MCP or API. Hosting, postgres, email, storage, containers, LLMs, voice and third-party APIs. Includes free tiers and 5 USD/mo in AI and Search credits. Top-ups through x402.

uizze/uizze.name: uizze
uizze/uizze.note: Official UIZZE MCP Registry source with the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint at https://uizze.com/mcp.

n3wth/r3.name: r3
n3wth/r3.note: Local Redis memory MCP for AI apps. Official registry: io.github.n3wth/r3. Site: https://r3.n3wth.com. Install: npx @n3wth/r3

Curviate/curviate-mcp.name: curviate-mcp
Curviate/curviate-mcp.note: Official MCP server for the Curviate API: LinkedIn search, messaging, connections, posts, Sales Navigator, and Recruiter for any MCP client. Thin stdio bridge to a hosted endpoint. Install: npx @curviate/mcp

amflimited/threadfox-lite.name: threadfox-lite
amflimited/threadfox-lite.note: Read-only Reddit research over stdio (uvx threadfox-lite): subreddit rules, communities for a topic, account standing, post status, through the user's own signed-in Chrome. MIT.

marvkr/better-design.name: better-design
marvkr/better-design.note: Design systems, UI and UX principles, icons and UI review for AI coding agents. Hosted MCP: https://better-design.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 or a Better Design API key). Local stdio package: npm better-design; requires BETTER_DESIGN_API_KEY. Free account; custom design systems use credits.

negm17111995/mcp-server.name: mcp-server
negm17111995/mcp-server.note: Hotel and flight search and booking on MAQAMI (3M+ hotels). Hosted MCP: https://mcp.maqami.co/ (Streamable HTTP, no API key). Local stdio bridge: npx -y maqami-travel. Canonical metadata is in server.json.

allxsmith/bestax.name: bestax
allxsmith/bestax.note: Props, working examples, --bulma-* CSS variables and Agent Skills for Bestax, React components for Bulma v1. Local stdio, offline, no API key. Package: bestax-mcp (npx -y bestax-mcp@1). MIT.

nowork-studio/notfair-plugin.name: notfair-plugin
nowork-studio/notfair-plugin.note: Hosted OAuth MCP for Google Ads, Meta Ads, X Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, Search Console, GA4, WordPress and GoHighLevel. Hosted MCP: https://notfair.co/api/mcp/notfair (Streamable HTTP, OAuth). The repo contains the MIT-licensed SEO, GEO and marketing skills and client configuration, not the server implementation. Canonical metadata is in server.json. Site: https://notfair.co

tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.name: moltnode-mcp
tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.note: MoltNode by Chord: read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Sui and more) and get DEX swap quotes with the unsigned transaction, approval and simulation via Chord. Hosted MCP: https://moltnode.ag/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no account or API key). Non-custodial: tools return unsigned transactions and the user's wallet signs. The MIT repo holds a stdio bridge to the hosted server (npx -y github:tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp), skills and a Dockerfile, not the hosted server itself. Canonical metadata is in server.json. Docs: https://moltnode.ag/agents

getchordlabs/chord.name: chord
getchordlabs/chord.note: Chord: best-route DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on 7 EVM chains (Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, Arc), plus token boards, candles, trades, wallet PnL, smart money, holders and LP pools (Solana data read-only). Hosted MCP: https://api.getchord.xyz/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key for data and swap tools at about 60 requests a minute; only chord_ask needs a Chord API key). Non-custodial. The MIT repo holds the TypeScript stdio bridge in agent/, plus the SDK, contracts and skills, not the hosted server itself. Canonical metadata is in server.json. Docs: https://getchord.xyz/docs/agents/mcp/

SergiuPogor/curlshot-mcp.name: curlshot-mcp
SergiuPogor/curlshot-mcp.note: Hosted MCP for CurlShot, a screenshot API: take_screenshot and list_devices return PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or scrolling video captures of public web pages. Hosted MCP: https://curlshot.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Bearer API key; free plan with 100 screenshots a month). The repo holds client setup, server.json and an agent skill, not the server implementation. Site: https://curlshot.com

fclairamb/solidping.name: solidping
fclairamb/solidping.note: SolidPing is a self-hostable uptime monitor (Go, AGPL-3.0) with 40+ check types, multi-region workers, status pages, incidents and on-call. Its MCP server exposes checks, results, incidents and status pages. Hosted MCP: https://solidping.io/api/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, needs a SolidPing account, free tier). Canonical metadata is in server.json. Docs: https://docs.solidping.io

daniel3303/stock-market-mcp-server.name: stock-market-mcp-server

jack-reson8/toolkb-mcp.name: toolkb-mcp
jack-reson8/toolkb-mcp.note: Local MCP server (npx, stdio) that turns links into clean Markdown: web pages, YouTube transcripts and playlists, App Store reviews. No API key, no account.

tubeagentkit/youtube-mcp.name: youtube-mcp
tubeagentkit/youtube-mcp.note: Hosted MCP (streamable HTTP): https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp. Needs an OAuth sign-in or an API key. YouTube transcripts with timestamps, caption languages, YouTube and in-channel search, channel and playlist video lists. MIT. Canonical metadata is in server.json.

azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server.name: dchub-mcp-server

Canonical metadata is in server.json.

robinfaraj/postel-mcp.name: postel-mcp

Canonical metadata is in server.json.

waynehamadi/datacircle.name: datacircle

Frank-Masciopinto/ironheights.name: ironheights
